# SRay

*a singleplayer-focused survival-friendly debuffed x-ray datapack for boosting your long hours of mining*

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/3H_JdggvQkY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Disclaimer

SRay is **NOT** a cheat! It is a datapack whose rationale is to limit wasting time mining resources when doing challenge runs/long runs.  
If you have any concerns, [consider opening an issue](https://github.com/yynaa/sray/issues).

## Configuration

Storage `sray:settings` contains the following fields:
```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "disappear_range": 24,
  "detect_range": 12,
  "cooldown": 60,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block": "minecraft:diamond_ore",
      "item": "minecraft:diamond",
      "color": "3847130"
    }
  ]
}
```

`disappear_range` is the distance at which item displays will disappear if there are no players nearby  
`detect_range` is the length of the scan in every axis
